text:
luis: Heads up — candidate Anna's consular stamping got pushed to next week (embassy gave a later appointment). She has her approval notice (I-797) but won't have the visa sticker before our target start 4/6. Any blockers for starting remotely / doing onboarding while visa is pending?

emma: Short answer: she can do remote onboarding activities (meetings, docs, training) but we cannot add her to payroll or benefits until we have work authorization docs. :white_check_mark:

maya: Correct. Payroll needs a valid work authorization to set up pay. For US hires that means one of: passport + visa stamp + I-94, or an unexpired EAD. We can provision equipment and Slack access ahead if manager ok.

raj: Would it be possible for her to start as a contractor for the first 2 weeks so we don't lose momentum? Manager okay to pay immediately if legal clears.

emma: We generally avoid contractor conversions for roles we plan to hire as employees (classification risk). If she does unpaid remote onboarding (no work on billable tasks) that's fine. We can mark it as "onboarding only" but it must be unpaid until docs are verified.

anna: Quick Q from my side — what exact docs should I bring to the I-9 appointment when I get back? Embassy said bring travel itinerary + original I-797.

immigration-bot: Here are common document combos for I-9 (bring originals to inspection):

```
List A (work authorization & identity):
- Unexpired US passport OR
- Passport + stamped H-1B visa + I-94
OR
List C (if EAD):
- Form I-766 (EAD) + ID
```

If you only have I-797 but no visa stamp yet, you still need the visa sticker + I-94 to show entry for employment in the US. For consular return-to-US timelines, ask the consulate about expedited pick-up if available.

luis: Thanks — embassy confirmed next available slot is 4/12, tacking onto travel won't get the sticker before 4/6. She can do learning sessions the week of 4/6 but won't accept assigned production tasks. OK?

maya: Also note benefits eligibility: our plan enrollment cutoff is the 20th of the month for a 1st-of-next-month effective date. If she is added to payroll with documents by 4/20, benefits will start 5/1. If paperwork completes after 4/20, benefits start 6/1. So timing matters if she needs coverage earlier.

emma: For PTO accrual and equity vesting, we will treat official start date as the first day she can be on payroll (i.e., when docs are verified). Onboarding-only days before that won't count as service. Documented in offer addendum — will send snippet.

raj: Can we request a consulate letter from People Ops stating purpose of travel / company sponsorship to try to get an earlier appointment?

emma: Yes we can provide a standard support letter and a draft travel itinerary template. I will send the PDF and wording. It includes hiring manager contact and job title.

luis: Anna also asked about laptop shipping — can we ship before visa stamped? We need signature to confirm receipt.

maya: Shipping laptop internationally can trigger customs/IT policy issues. If she's currently outside the US, IT prefers to wait until she has a confirmed US address. If she's already in the US on a different visa status, we can ship earlier. Check with IT.

anna: I'm currently in the US on a visitor stay and will leave for stamping next week. If I leave, will payroll still process quickly when I return with stamp?

immigration-bot: If you depart the US for consular processing, your I-9 will be completed when you return with a valid visa stamp and updated I-94. Payroll can be queued but cannot be paid until the I-9 is completed. Provide scanned copies in advance to expedite.

emma: Practical plan: 1) We do remote onboarding week of 4/6 (meetings, training, paperwork drafts) unpaid. 2) People Ops will send support letter for consulate today. 3) Anna to scan passport + I-797 + appointment confirmation to People Ops so payroll can pre-stage setup. 4) When Anna returns with visa + I-94, payroll completes I-9 and sets official start date (we'll aim for backdated pay if allowed — payroll will confirm).

maya: I'll flag payroll to expect the docs and to pre-configure employee record. They can sometimes backdate pay to first day on payroll if manager approves exception — we'll confirm after we see docs.

raj: Sounds good. Manager approves unpaid onboarding week to avoid losing hire. :thumbsup:

luis: Great — Anna, we'll get the letter and itinerary template in Slack DM. Please upload scans as soon as you have them.

anna: Thank you all — appreciate the quick help. I'll upload docs after my appointment and confirm travel.

emma: I'll drop the consulate letter in #support-docs and DM it to you, Anna. Also attaching the small offer addendum language about start date/billing — please review when you have a minute.

luis: Closing loop — next check-in Friday 4/9 to confirm appointment status.

maya: Noted. Payroll will stand by.

immigration-bot: If anyone needs the I-9 acceptable document matrix in a one-pager, say so and I'll post.

emma: Thanks team. :sparkles:
